mapper.update: /*insertMasterMpSoSellerWarhsngProcGrdt*/ INSERT INTO ICOMGRDT( BUYER , GR_NO , GR_SEQ , STATUS , SEND_DATE , SEND_TIME , ADD_DATE , ADD_TIME , CHANGE_DATE , CHANGE_TIME , CONFIRM_DATE , CONFIRM_TIME , SELLER , GR_DATE , PAY_TERMS , USANCE_DAYS , BUYER_ITEM_NO , SELLER_ITEM_NO , DESCRIPTION , SPECIFICATION , CUR , UNIT_MEASURE , ITEM_QTY , UNIT_PRICE , ITEM_AMT , INV_NO , INV_SEQ , PO_NO , PO_SEQ , DO_NO , DO_SEQ , EXCHANGE_RATE , GR_LOC_AMT , LC_NO , AP_NO , PROCESS_TYPE , RO_QTY , ADD_USER_ID , NOTIFY , PAYER , PAYEE , GR_BAL_QTY , AGENT , AGENT_PRICE , CLOSE_DATE , CHANGE_USER_ID , AGENT_ITEM_AMT , LEGACY_PO_NO , LEGACY_PO_SEQ , BYIT_COMORG_CODE ) ( SELECT B.BUYER , #{GR_NO} , TO_CHAR( #{GR_SEQ}, 'FM000000') , 'C' , ' ' , ' ' , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24MISS') , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24MISS') , ' ' , ' ' , B.SELLER , #{GR_DATE} , A.PAY_TERMS , A.USANCE_DAYS , B.BUYER_ITEM_NO , B.SELLER_ITEM_NO , B.DESCRIPTION , B.SPECIFICATION , A.CUR , B.UNIT_MEASURE , #{GR_QTY} , B.UNIT_PRICE , ROUND(B.UNIT_PRICE * #{GR_QTY}) , C.INV_NO , C.INV_SEQ , B.PO_NO , B.PO_SEQ , '' , '' , '12' , '1' , B.LC_NO , '' , A.PROCESS_TYPE , '0' , 'FTP' , A.NOTIFY , A.PAYER , A.PAYEE , #{GR_QTY} , A.AGENT , B.AGENT_PRICE , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') , 'FTP' , ROUND(B.AGENT_PRICE * #{GR_QTY}) , B.LEGACY_PO_NO , B.LEGACY_PO_SEQ , B.BYIT_COMORG_CODE FROM ICOMPOHD A, ICOMPODT B, ICOMIVDT C WHERE B.BUYER = #{BUYER} AND B.PO_NO = #{PO_NO} AND B.PO_SEQ = #{PO_SEQ} AND A.BUYER = B.BUYER AND A.PO_NO = B.PO_NO AND B.BUYER = C.BUYER AND B.PO_NO = C.PO_NO AND B.PO_SEQ = C.PO_SEQ AND C.BUYER = #{BUYER} AND C.INV_NO = #{INV_NO} AND C.INV_SEQ = #{INV_SEQ} AND A.STATUS <> 'D' AND B.STATUS <> 'D' )
